featuredReviews.title: The BEST all inclusive tour
featuredReviews.text:
Whole experience was amazing. Was able to book last minute the day before.
It is worth every penny and more affordable than me booking a private car plus admission fees, to take me to Cape Coast. Received pick up location the night before. The driver was friendly. The journey was around 4 hours from Accra but the car was very comfortable with aircon.

Cape Coast castle was quite emotional for me. Wish I had more time as the tour was only 45mins but Elina Castle tour was slightly longer with more time to explore the castle and pay my respects to my ancestors. The tour guides were very knowledgeable.

Pre-ordered lunch before arriving at Kakum National Park which was ready when we arrived. Lots of walking and step steps but that made the experience more enjoyable. The canopy walk was breathtaking, though I didn't look down.

featuredReviews.title: When you come to Accra, you must experience the Cape Coast and Kakum National Park  with Expedition Tours!
featuredReviews.text:
When you come to Accra, you must experience the Cape Coast and Kakum National Park with Expedition Tours! I had an amazing time with Emmanuel and Christopher.

They were wonderful, and I would absolutely do it again to learn even more about the rich history and beautiful culture Ghana has to offer.

Expedition Tours was incredibly accommodating and responded to my inquiries right away.

Thank you, Expedition Tours, for an unforgettable experience! I highly recommend you to anyone visiting Ghana.

featuredReviews.title: Must visit Cape Coast Castle!!!
featuredReviews.text:
Wow, what an impactful experience. I booked this because I wanted to go on the canopy tour, but the Cape Coast Castle will stay with me forever - reading and watching videos does not compare to being in the dungeons and walking the grounds.

Additionally, I met a new friend and learned all about Singapore during the long drive, which our guide was very efficient and safe with.
